reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread under her message in #central-team. I said I'd noted the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. as unverified and wouldn't treat it as the real date.

I looked through the shared files Pree can see and the #central-team history and found nothing about Brackenwater, so I had nothing to check the date against. I told her to confirm it from the signed contract, the account owner or the deal desk (June Osei-Lark), and to post it in #central-team once it's confirmed.

I didn't use search or read any channels or files outside what Pree can see. No approval was needed, because a renewal date is an account fact, not a finance figure.
